edit.ability:
(OFS) Auto-equip Polar Star.
(WOF) Every time a prime creature is defeated, gain Dorito Counters equal to the star level of the killed creature. 
Whenever this creature is attacked, it loses a Dorito Counter for each 2 HP lost.
